bridge.title: Four things I noticed

beats.title: 63.7K on Instagram, and a $3,000 mentorship behind a Buy button.
beats.text: “Become my mentee” on felonytrades.co goes straight to a Whop checkout: $3,000, one click, no application and no call. You've mentored 500+ traders that way, so the demand is real. What's missing is the conversation for everyone who hesitates at $3,000.

beats.title: 83 Sunday streams in a row, and no next step at the end of them.
beats.text: Sunday Stock Service runs every week at 9PM EST, and each episode pulls 1.2K to 1.9K views. Those are people who show up for you on a Sunday night. Right now the only path from there to the mentorship is a $3,000 checkout.

beats.title: A $3,000 decision gets two sentences and a cart.
beats.text: The mentorship page on Whop is a tagline, two sentences and four FAQs, next to the same cart as the $100 live group. The ones who aren't sure leave without asking, and the ones who aren't a fit can buy anyway. An application and a call fix both.

beats.title: “Whop already works.” It stays.
beats.text: Whop keeps the checkout, the community and the $100 live group. The funnel only sits in front of the mentorship: one page, a short application, a call with you or your team, and emails that get people to the call. Your own FAQ already says what a call is for.
beats.quote: “We care, first and foremost. We care not only about your success as a trader but you as a person.”
beats.source: First Step Trading FAQ on Whop

bridge.closing: So instead of explaining it, I built it. The page, the application, the emails and the ads, all below.

cards.title: You watch the clips, then freeze live
cards.body: The setups look obvious on a replay. At the open you hesitate, chase, or take a trade your plan never allowed.

cards.title: You trade alone
cards.body: No one sees your entries, no one asks why you took them, and the same mistakes repeat every week.

cards.title: Signals aren't a skill
cards.body: Copying alerts gets you in a trade. It doesn't teach you why, when to size down, or when to sit out.

mechanism.title: Learn it live, then do it yourself
mechanism.body: You trade the session next to Felony in real time, learn the reasoning behind every entry and exit in live classes, and build the habits that keep you consistent. Every class is recorded, so nothing is missed.

preCallEmails.subject: You're booked: here's what happens next
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Your call is booked for {{call_time}}. The link is in your calendar invite.

Before we talk:
1. Keep the time free.
2. Think about where you are: how long you've been trading, what you trade, and what keeps going wrong.

One note: nobody on my team will ever ask you to pay through a DM. Payments only happen through the official links from this email address.

Talk soon,
Felony

preCallEmails.subject: Why watching isn't the same as trading
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Every setup looks obvious on a replay. Live, with a position open, it's a different game.

That's why the mentorship is built around trading the session live, then breaking it down in classes you can re-watch for life.

On the call we'll look at where your process breaks today.

Felony

preCallEmails.subject: "My account is too small"
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

The question I get most: do I need a large account?

No. Small or large, the work is the same: proper habits, fixed risk, and patience. Size comes later.

If money is the worry, bring it up on the call. We'd rather tell you to wait than have you trade money you can't afford to lose.

Felony

preCallEmails.subject: What we'll cover on the call
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

The call takes about 30 minutes:

1. Where you are now and what you've tried.
2. What you want trading to look like in a year.
3. How the mentorship works, what it costs, and whether it fits you.

If it isn't a fit, we'll tell you. No pressure either way.

Felony

preCallEmails.subject: Tomorrow: your call with the FelonyTrades team
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Quick reminder: your call is tomorrow at {{call_time}}.

If the time doesn't work anymore, reschedule with the link in your invite so someone else can take the slot.

See you tomorrow,
Felony

preCallEmails.subject: Today's the day
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Your call is today at {{call_time}}. Find a quiet spot and have your questions ready.

Talk soon,
Felony
